function.name: websites.Fetch
function.description: Fetch a website URL and return its main content in Reader Mode: "markdown" or "text" strip navigation, sidebars, footers, scripts and ads and return only the article. "html" returns the raw source. Impersonates a real browser with User-Agent and Client Hint headers so scraping is not blocked.

url.description: The full http or https URL to fetch, e.g. "https://example.com/page"

user_agent.description: Optional User-Agent preset name from websites.List, e.g. "chrome-windows", "firefox-linux", "safari-macos". Defaults to "chrome-windows".

format.description: Optional output format: "markdown" (default, Reader Mode), "text" (Reader Mode plain text), or "html" (raw source).

function.name: websites.List
function.description: List all available User-Agent presets with their platform and whether they are mobile.

function.name: websites.Stat
function.description: Return the HTTP status and response headers of a website URL without fetching its body.

url.description: The full http or https URL to inspect, e.g. "https://example.com"

user_agent.description: Optional User-Agent preset name from websites.List, e.g. "chrome-windows". Defaults to "chrome-windows".
